nodes.description: address private owner; privileged account used for access control in ensure, approveAndCall and transferownership
mapping(address => uint) public balanceOf; token balances mutated with unchecked + and -
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) public allowance; spender approvals mutated with unchecked subtraction
mapping(address => bool) private canSale; addresses whitelisted to bypass transfer restrictions
address tradeAddress; secondary privileged address that bypasses the ensure() checks
mapping(address => uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-address counter incremented on every transferFrom
uint256 private _saleNum; maximum number of sales per address enforced by condition()
uint256 private _minSale; minimum transfer amount enforced by condition()
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum transfer amount enforced by condition()
uint public totalSupply; total token supply set in the constructor
string public name; token name set in the constructor
string public symbol; token symbol set in the constructor
uint constant public decimals = 18; used to scale supply and approveAndCall minting
function transfer(address,uint) public payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
function transferFrom(address,address,uint) public payable; performs unchecked allowance/balance mutations and ensure() validation
function ensure(address,address,uint) internal view; returns true for owner/tradeAddress/whitelisted addresses, otherwise applies condition()
function condition(address,uint) internal view; enforces _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale sale limits
function approve(address,uint) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without validation
function approveAndCall(address,uint256) public; owner-only mint of balanceOf[spender] and whitelisting of spender
function transferownership(address) public; owner-only update of tradeAddress privilege
constructor(string,string,uint256) payable; sets metadata, totalSupply, owner and initial balance
msg.sender; externally controlled caller used as allowance owner, owner check and constructor owner
balanceOf[_to] += _value; unchecked addition that can silently overflow
balanceOf[_from] -= _value; unchecked subtraction performed after only a >= guard
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value; unchecked approval decrement
balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)); owner-controlled unchecked overwrite minting arbitrary balances
ensure() short-circuit granting unrestricted transfers to owner, tradeAddress and canSale[_from] holders, bypassing condition()
payable transfer() delegating into public payable transferFrom() state-mutating entry point without reentrancy protection
